evidence: Full fifteen-stage isolated verifier on the current integrated candidate (input 7f3ff4fa33b2...): 522 tests, 4 opt-in skips, 0 failures, packaged unsigned app smoke and helper protocol check included.

Acceptance: Fake-clock tests prove no late Active transition/notification after pause or sleep, no sleep follow-up, orderly shutdown does not mimic a crash, and partial/failed scans never claim all evidence current. Suspend notification-settings and authorization callbacks in synthetic tests; cancellation must be rechecked at a main-actor-serialized OS submission boundary for pause, sleep, quit and settings changes. Already-submitted notifications are not retroactively revoked.; Ordinary targeted file-change hints, not only event-loss gaps, durably invalidate affected scan passes before an in-flight stale slice can publish; isolated controller/probe/store tests cover equal-time hints, pause/sleep, restart and unaffected roots without false deletion. The callback-to-store path has bounded coalescing and stream identity; pending receipt persistence failures fail closed and survive retry/restart as explicit uncertainty. A receipt accepted during transaction preparation fences final commit, not just store entry. Prove before/after commit order and rollback with no lock across traversal or reconciliation preparation.
